UNITY CUSTOM POSE

Your ideas. Your characters. Your own little world.

Got a specific pose or scene in mind? Let’s build it.

Unity Custom Pose is a personalized 3D pose service made around your references, concepts, and preferences. From character positioning to custom 3D backgrounds, we’ll work on bringing your visual ideas to life.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

  • Custom 3D pose based on your references.
  • Custom 3D background.
  • Solo, Duo, or Group packages.
  • Two final image formats: 3:4 and 9:16.
  • 1x 3D background revision.
  • 1x final pose revision.

UNITY OMAKASE POSE

You pick. We create. Easy as that.

A little surprise, a little creativity, a whole lot of PLAYMODE.

Unity Omakase Pose features pre-designed 3D pose concepts created and curated by PLAYMODE Studio. Simply choose from the available concepts, submit your order, and leave the creative process to us.

No need to prepare a custom concept. Just pick your favorite and let the magic happen.

WHAT’S INCLUDED

  • Pre-designed pose concept.
  • Selection from available concepts.
  • Two final image formats: 3:4 and 9:16.
  • Additional 3D assets available at an extra cost.
  • Revisions subject to mutual agreement.
LIMITED DROP Only 5 slots are available for each opening. First come, first served based on Order Form submission time.

how the magic happens

Ready to make something?

Every service has its own process. Pick your playground and follow the steps!

UNITY CUSTOM POSE

From your references to your final visual.

  1. SEND US YOUR IDEASFill out the Custom Pose Order Form and submit your references, desired concept, and other details.
  2. BACKGROUND FIRSTPLAYMODE will review your references and create the requested 3D background. The estimated production time depends on its complexity. We reserve the right to decline requests that are too complex or technically challenging.
  3. TAKE A LOOKOnce the background is ready, you’ll receive a preview and get 1x revision opportunity.
  4. APPROVE & PAYHappy with the background? Great! Proceed with a 50% down payment of the total order cost.
  5. POSE TIMEPose production starts once your down payment is confirmed.
  6. FINAL CHECKYou’ll receive a preview of the completed pose and get 1x additional revision opportunity.
  7. PAY & GET YOUR FILESComplete the remaining balance, and your final files will be delivered through Google Drive.

UNITY OMAKASE POSE

Pick your concept. Leave the rest to us.

  1. FIND YOUR FAVORITEBrowse the available Omakase concepts and choose the one you like.
  2. FILL THE FORMSubmit the Omakase Order Form with your selected concept and required details.
  3. SECURE YOUR SLOTSlots are assigned based on the order in which Order Forms are received. Each opening has a maximum of 5 slots.
  4. LET US COOKWe’ll start working on your selected concept. Estimated production time is around 1–2 hours, depending on adjustments and technical requirements.
  5. IT’S READY!You’ll receive a notification once your order is completed.
  6. TIME TO PAYComplete your payment within 12 hours after receiving the completion notification.
  7. DELIVERY TIMEOnce payment is confirmed, your final files will be sent through Google Drive.

GRAPHIC DESIGN

Your ideas, but make them visual.

  1. PICK YOUR SERVICEChoose the design service that fits your needs.
  2. SEND THE BRIEFSubmit your brief, references, and other required details.
  3. LET’S TALK DETAILSWe’ll review your request and confirm the final price and payment terms.
  4. DESIGN IN PROGRESSOnce the down payment is confirmed, we’ll start working on your design.
  5. REVIEW TIMECheck the preview and discuss revisions according to the agreed terms.
  6. FINAL PAYMENTComplete the remaining balance before final delivery.
  7. FILES INCOMINGYour final design files will be delivered through Google Drive.
before we play...

Terms & Conditions

A few ground rules to keep everything smooth, clear, and fun for everyone. Please take a moment to read the terms before placing an order.

GENERAL TERMS

General terms
  1. Customers must provide clear references and complete order details before production.
  2. Production estimates may vary depending on project complexity and technical requirements.
  3. Customers are responsible for ensuring the information submitted through the Order Form is accurate.
  4. Final results are not guaranteed to be 99% identical to references due to technical limitations, software capabilities, and creative adjustments.
  5. Final files will be delivered through Google Drive after the required payment has been completed.
  6. By placing an order, customers are considered to have read and agreed to the applicable Terms & Conditions.

UNITY CUSTOM POSE

Production
  1. The 3D background will be created before the down payment is made.
  2. Production estimates depend on the complexity of the requested background.
  3. PLAYMODE Studio reserves the right to decline requests considered too complex or technically challenging.
  4. Pose production will only begin after the background has been approved and the 50% down payment has been confirmed.
Revision
  1. Customers receive 1x revision for the 3D background before down payment.
  2. Customers receive 1x additional revision for the final pose after the preview is provided.
  3. Additional revisions will incur extra charges.
  4. Major changes to the original concept or references may require additional fees and feasibility review.
Payment & cancellation
  1. A 50% down payment is required after 3D background approval.
  2. The remaining balance must be paid before final file delivery.
  3. Down payments are non-refundable once pose production has started.
  4. Orders cannot be cancelled once pose production has started.

UNITY OMAKASE POSE

Slot system
  1. Each opening is limited to a maximum of 5 slots.
  2. Slot allocation is based on the order in which Order Forms are received, not payment time.
  3. Slot confirmation will be communicated by PLAYMODE Studio.
  4. Customers must select from the available pre-designed concepts.
Production
  1. Concepts and poses are predetermined by PLAYMODE Studio.
  2. Custom concept or major pose changes are not included.
  3. Estimated production time is approximately 1–2 hours and may vary depending on adjustments and technical requirements.
  4. Additional 3D asset requests will incur extra charges.
Payment & cancellation
  1. Payment is required after production is completed.
  2. Customers must complete payment within 12 hours after receiving the completion notification.
  3. Final files will only be delivered after payment is confirmed.
  4. Orders may be cancelled before production starts.
  5. Orders cannot be cancelled once production has started.
Revision
  1. Revisions are subject to mutual agreement between the customer and PLAYMODE Studio.
  2. Revisions do not include changing the predetermined concept or main pose.

GRAPHIC DESIGN

Graphic design terms
  1. Customers must submit a clear brief and references before production.
  2. Final pricing depends on project complexity and requirements.
  3. Payment consists of a down payment and remaining balance, with payment terms confirmed before production.
  4. Production begins after the down payment is confirmed.
  5. Revision terms will be agreed upon before production.
  6. Final files will be delivered after full payment.
questions?

QUESTIONS? WE GOT YOU.

A few things you might want to know before jumping in.

How do I place an order?

Easy! Choose your preferred service, fill out the corresponding Order Form, and follow the ordering process.

How does the Custom Pose payment work?

You’ll pay a 50% down payment after the 3D background is completed, reviewed, and approved. The remaining balance is paid before final delivery.

How many revisions do I get for Custom Pose?

You get 2 revisions in total: 1x for the 3D background and 1x for the final pose.

Can I request a custom 3D background?

Absolutely! Custom 3D background requests are included in all Unity Custom Pose packages, subject to feasibility.

Can PLAYMODE decline my Custom Pose request?

Yes. Requests considered too complex or technically challenging may be declined.

How many Omakase slots are available?

Only 5 slots per opening. So keep an eye out for the next drop!

How are Omakase slots assigned?

First come, first served based on Order Form submission time — not payment time.

When do I pay for Omakase Pose?

After your order is completed. You’ll have 12 hours from the completion notification to complete the payment.

Can I cancel my Omakase order?

You can cancel before production starts. Once production has started, cancellation is no longer accepted.

Can I change the Omakase concept or pose?

Omakase concepts and poses are predetermined. Revisions can be discussed by mutual agreement, but changing the main concept or pose isn’t included.

How long does Omakase production take?

Around 1–2 hours, depending on adjustments and technical requirements.

What file formats will I receive?

Both Unity Custom Pose and Unity Omakase Pose include 3:4 and 9:16 formats.

How will I receive my final files?

Through Google Drive, once the required payment has been completed.
